data.cause: The shared local G-Labs service on 127.0.0.1:8765 went down while several films were generating animation, causing animation failures across runs. EP05’s planner then found its remaining target mix infeasible; its source-expansion check saw 95 clean cuts versus 75 needed and skipped searching, although total cut count does not guarantee enough eligible cuts in each target category.
data.fix_now: Restore the G-Labs service on port 8765 and verify it responds, then resume EP05 at stage 3 so failed animation work can be retried. Re-run the mix plan after checking category-specific eligible-cut counts; if a category is still short, expand/review sources for that category rather than relying on the total clean-cut count.
data.prevent: Limit concurrent generation jobs to what the 16 GB RAM/4 GB GPU machine and G-Labs service can sustain; add service health checks and backoff before animation retries. Make mix planning diagnose per-category shortages and trigger targeted source expansion or an explicit target relaxation when a category is infeasible, instead of skipping expansion based only on total video capacity.
